scope: table family of plenora_core::catalog (data-tools2), profiles wide/narrow/distinct/spilled

semantics.memory_metric: median over repetitions of PeakWorkingSet64 read at the measurement_ready barrier (inputs and output alive); incremental = median(operation) - median(baseline)
semantics.secondary_metric: median growth of WorkingSet64 over input_ready during the measured phase, polled every 5 ms (misses spikes shorter than the poll)
semantics.buffer_accounting: Arrow buffers deduplicated by allocation start (Buffer::data_ptr), counted by capacity; output_new = output allocations not shared with any input allocation
semantics.noise_flag: inconclusive_noise if incremental <= 0; noisy if interquartile spread of baseline or operation peaks > 0.5 x incremental; else ok
semantics.budget_estimate: max(incremental peak, phase WS growth operation - baseline); peak_masked_by_fixture_transient when phase growth > 2x incremental peak and > 1 MiB
semantics.superlinear_flag: per-row incremental (or kernel time) between the last two observed sizes grows by more than 1.5x; undetermined when a point is noisy or non-positive
